themes.label: AI as integration and development tool
themes.definition: Optimistic framing of AI, alongside globalization and IT, as a tool for integration and development of peoples, conditional on good use.
themes.inclusion: Passages describing AI as a tool helping integration or development, including with a 'if used well' caveat.
themes.exclusion: Passages where risk is the dominant framing.
themes.boundary_cases: A brief caveat about good use does not make the passage a duality passage unless harms are named.

examples.quote: artificial intelligence and real-time communication are tools that help the integration and development of our peoples — of course, if they are used well

themes.label: AI listed with globalization and IT
themes.definition: AI named within a list of modern trends and tools without specific discussion.
themes.inclusion: Passages naming AI among globalization, information technology and communications.
themes.boundary_cases: Code alongside the development theme when the list carries an evaluative claim.

examples.quote: We are convinced that globalization, information technology, artificial intelligence and real-time communication are tools

value.rationale: Single Uruguayan 2023 passage with an optimistic, list-style mention of AI as a tool for integration and development if used well.
